items.prompt: Don't talk to me now; I'm ___ the middle of a film.

explanation.en: We say in the middle of.

optionNotes.en: At the middle is not used in this fixed expression.
On the middle is not possible here.

items.prompt: Most visitors come to the island ___ ferry.

explanation.en: Means of transport without an article takes by.

optionNotes.en: With is not used for transport.
On needs an article: on the ferry.

items.prompt: I stayed ___ work until seven yesterday.

optionNotes.en: On work is not used for place.
In work means having a job, not being at the workplace.

items.prompt: Their wedding photos were published ___ a glossy magazine.

explanation.es: «En una revista» es in a magazine.

optionNotes.en: On is used for TV and radio, not magazines.
At is not used with publications.

items.prompt: The train left five minutes early, so we weren't ___ time to catch it.

explanation.en: In time means early enough to do something.
explanation.es: In time = a tiempo para hacer algo; on time = puntual.

optionNotes.en: By time is not an expression; in time means early enough to do something.
At time is not an expression here.
Correct: in time to catch it.
